statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations
The patient has transient neurological deficits
The patient has a history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the patient's current benefit plan
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to detect intermittent arrhythmias
CPT 93271 is medically necessary to identify paroxysmal atrial fibrillation associated with the patient's transient neurological symptoms
